product_risk_or_requirement: Confirm whether TriageWell's symptom-triage and urgency-recommendation function is captured by Vietnam's AI Law and the official high-risk AI system list before any Vietnam production launch
current_state: AI Law 134/2025/QH15 took effect 2026-03-01 and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg published a high-risk AI catalog effective 2026-08-15, but the catalog's exact category text has not yet been matched against this specific use case
product_requirement: Legal and compliance must produce a signed classification memo mapping TriageWell's exact function, deployment role, and target users against the current AI Law and high-risk list before Vietnam production release
acceptance_criteria: Given the finalized Vietnam product scope and deployment role, When the Vietnam launch-readiness review is requested, Then a signed classification memo referencing the current AI Law and high-risk AI system list, with a dated legal sign-off, must be attached to the release record
deadline_or_trigger: Before any Vietnam production launch, and re-checked before any material change to scope or market
evidence_needed: Signed classification memo, AI system inventory entry, and legal sign-off citing the current law and high-risk list text

product_risk_or_requirement: Determine whether TriageWell's urgency-recommendation function qualifies as a medical device or safety component under EU MDR, and therefore as an Annex I high-risk AI system, ahead of the staged 2028-08-02 embedded-product deadline
current_state: The EU AI Act's current published timeline applies high-risk obligations to AI systems embedded in products such as medical devices from 2028-08-02, and the Commission's own overview does not explicitly resolve whether a symptom-triage decision-support chatbot is in scope; no MDR software-as-medical-device qualification assessment has been completed yet
product_requirement: Commission or complete a documented MDR/SaMD qualification and EU AI Act applicability assessment, and build any resulting conformity, risk-management, and human-oversight obligations into the release checklist before EU production launch
acceptance_criteria: Given a finalized EU launch candidate and its intended clinical use description, When EU release approval is requested, Then a signed MDR/SaMD qualification memo and an EU AI Act applicability assessment, including the target obligation date, must both be on file
deadline_or_trigger: Before any EU production launch, and before the 2028-08-02 embedded-product obligation date in any case
evidence_needed: MDR/SaMD qualification memo, AI Act applicability assessment, and named regulatory owner sign-off

product_risk_or_requirement: Model urgency-tier recommendations are not yet independently validated on the pilot's own patient population, creating a risk of the Epic Sepsis Model pattern of much lower real-world sensitivity than reported validation performance
current_state: Only vendor-reported validation metrics exist; no independent external validation against this pilot's population and no shadow-mode comparison against nurse triage has been run
product_requirement: Require an independent external validation study covering sensitivity, specificity, and AUC on a sample of this pilot's own population, plus a minimum shadow-mode period against live nurse triage, before the AI recommendation can be shown to nurses as decision support
acceptance_criteria: Given the trained triage model and the pilot population's shadow-mode data, When the model is proposed for nurse-facing production use, Then an independent validation report with sensitivity, specificity, and AUC on that population, reviewed by the Clinical AI Safety Review Board, must be signed off
deadline_or_trigger: Before the AI recommendation is shown to nurses in live production; re-triggered by any model or vendor change
evidence_needed: Independent validation report and a signed shadow-mode comparison summary

product_risk_or_requirement: No mandatory subgroup or bias evaluation is yet defined for urgency-tier recommendations, creating a risk of the Optum Impact Pro pattern where a proxy-driven model under-triages historically underserved groups without anyone noticing
current_state: A bias evaluation plan is drafted but not yet run; demographic breakdown of nurse-override (upgrade) rates is not yet part of the release checklist
product_requirement: Require a subgroup performance evaluation, by self-reported demographic group and language, with a defined pass/fail threshold before each model release, and route any failing release back to retraining
acceptance_criteria: Given a candidate model release, When the release-readiness checklist is run, Then a subgroup evaluation report showing no subgroup upgrade-rate gap above the agreed threshold must be attached and signed by the Clinical AI Safety Officer
deadline_or_trigger: Before nurse-override monitoring begins; re-run before every subsequent model release
evidence_needed: Subgroup evaluation report with a defined pass/fail threshold
